notes.title: Patch 0.3.19
notes.content:
0.3.19
	-Load screen added!
	-Books can now be read and give gameplay tips!

notes.title: Patch 0.3.18
notes.content:
0.3.18
	-Upgraded pathing to latest version
	-Keys auto use on locked doors and chests (if they take a key)
	-Locked indicator added to chests
	-Enemies ignore traps until player enters room
	-Cool Downs for attacks reset when an enemy room is cleared
	-Attacks with 0 cool down do not get locked if you swap them out
	-Level up cards should increase in size when hovered over
	-For on screen dialog, hitting the next button skips text to end of animation
	-Fixed some teleporting enemies
	-Camera auto aligns with doors when traversing
	-Mouse pointer no longer bound to screen for more accurate pointing
	-Clicking create on a new file will take you right to slime selecting
	-Tutorial Improvements

notes.title: Patch 0.3.17
notes.content:
[url=https://ibb.co/mbCLV1M][img]https://i.ibb.co/JmRfw0M/image.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Patch 0.3.17[/h1]

More play tester feedback changes! Thank you all so much for your feedback!!

	-Added door symbol on map/minimap
	-Corridors should show on map after finding
	-Corridors should show on map after reload
	-Treasure room should show on map after discovering and reload
	-Store room should show on map after discovering and reload
	-Added throw button
		-Press F on keyboard or X on controller to throw an object if you can throw it
		-Primarily for controllers so they can throw bombs at walls (sometimes you find a hidden room)
	-Enhanced feedback when hit
		-more screen aberation
		-slime lights up
	-Fixed bug with locked doors and enemy rooms started
	-Added locked symbol to doors when locked

notes.title: Patch 0.3.16
notes.content:
0.3.16 - Feedback changes! Quick hitters

[list]
[*] 	Human archers get tired after running for a short time
[*] 	Crabs have a .5 sec delay to pinch
[*] 	Humans with sticks have a .5 sec to delay to swing
[*] 	The bat bite attack has a .5 sec delay
[*] 	The bat is disoriented after the jump attack
[*] 	Bigger click hit box for humans
[*] 	Bigger click hit box for the small potion
[*] 	New Icon for game when running
[*] 	2 seconds of damage immunity added when traversing doors
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.3.15
notes.content:
0.3.15
	[list]
[*] New boss!!
Evil Mage can now show up in the dungeon
[*] 	New boss system
 		Now you should see one for the two bosses on the level 1 and a different boss on level 2
		On repeat levels it will be random, but you should fight each boss at least once
[*] 	Shrines should load as cleared properly
[*] 	Slime should back up if on top of enemy it is trying to attack
	Trying this out, might remove if it causes more problems than fixes
[/list]
